sets.rule:
all fundamental discriminants D with 100 <= |D| <= 1300 (both signs), minus the 8 development characters;
numpy default_rng(20261125).permutation of that list; walk it and keep D unless |D| is already kept (distinct conductors),
until 56 are kept.  Triples: default_rng(20261126).choice(27720, 2000, replace=False) on the lexicographic list of the
triples of the kept set sorted by D.  Predictions: tmlib (pmax = 1e5; 1e5 -> 1e6 changes P by < 1e-8 relative).

method: tmlib.py (recipe = sum over the 8 swap terms, multilinear jets; diag = AFE diagonal with sharp cutoff at sqrt(C); kirk = prod pairs / prod singles; ind = prod singles; no3 = A_3 replaced by prod A_ij; lead = h(0) prod ln(q_j t / 2 pi)); integrals by 96-point Gauss-Legendre in ln t
